subject: Renewal + Amendment: Add isolated staging cluster and 24-month term — Medipulse
messages:
From: Ana Silva <ana.silva@medipulse.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Reyes <carlos.reyes@medipulse.com>, Procurement <procurement@medipulse.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — Medipulse (coming up June)

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the heads up about the upcoming renewal. We're broadly happy with Redwood but have two new asks from infra and security that we need folded into the term rather than a separate PO: 

1) We need a separate, isolated staging cluster in our AWS us-west-2 account (same VPC boundary but dedicated cluster with network-level isolation). This will be used for regulated feature testing and must not share KV cache or prefixes with prod.
2) We want to move to a 24-month term with a fixed price (to avoid quarterly variability) and would like to discuss a small committed-discount in exchange for the extended term.

Can you also confirm whether SOC2 evidence and the updated SLA will be attached to the amendment? Procurement wants the docs before signatures.

Best,
Ana Silva
Director, Platform Engineering
Medipulse

---
Attachments referenced: request_matrix.xlsx (they included a short table in the body)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Ana Silva <ana.silva@medipulse.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — Medipulse (coming up June)

Hi Ana — thanks for the clear ask and the matrix. Happy to coordinate. Quick answers up front:

- Isolation: We can provision a dedicated staging cluster in your us-west-2 tenancy with separate network and KV cache. We will treat it as a "private environment" variant (same control plane, isolated data path).
- Term: 24 months is fine; we can provide a 12% committed discount off list in exchange for the longer term and a minimal 6-month early-termination clause.
- Compliance artifacts: SOC2 and the updated SLA (Redwood_SLA_2027.pdf) will be attached to the amendment pack.

Kimberly, Neha — looping you in to scope the technical constraints and to draft the SOW appendix that enumerates the isolation controls and provisioning timeline. Procurement at Medipulse needs the compliance bundle and a clear cutover plan (dates).

Next steps proposed:
- Kimberly to produce a short SOW addendum (isolation controls + runbook) — due Wed 12 May
- Neha to create the pricing amendment (24-month term + discount + billing cadence) — due Tue 11 May
- Connor to coordinate DocuSign and procurement contact

Ana / Carlos — can you confirm desired target live date for the staging cluster? Also flag any network / security reviewers we should include.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ana Silva <ana.silva@medipulse.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — Medipulse (coming up June)

Hi Ana / Connor — attached is the draft SOW addendum for the isolated staging cluster (SOW_Medipulse_v2.pdf). High-level points:

- Dedicated staging cluster scoped as a "Private Environment" with network ACLs and separate KV cache.
- No shared prefix caching between prod and staging; explicit ACLs enforced at the runtime layer.
- Provisioning timeline: 4 weeks from signed amendment (2 weeks for infra prep, 2 weeks for validation and handoff).
- Operational handover includes runbook, a rolling validation plan, and a one-day run with your infra team.

I included a small section on sequencing for data egress and backup retention (we default to 30-day retention for staging unless you prefer less).

Connor — I left a short action item for procurement language. Neha, please drop the pricing amendment in the same Drive folder so procurement has a single source of truth.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW_Medipulse_v2.pdf (SOW addendum, 6 pages)

From: Carlos Reyes <carlos.reyes@medipulse.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Ana Silva <ana.silva@medipulse.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@medipulse.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 May 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + Amendment: Add isolated staging cluster and 24-month term — Medipulse

Connor / team — quick update from procurement:

- Procurement has reviewed the SOW_Medipulse_v2.pdf and SOC2_Report_Q1_2027.pdf. Two questions: 1) Can you confirm the SLA uptime target for the isolated environment (is it the same SLA as prod?), and 2) we need explicit language around audit log retention for the staging cluster.
- Procurement is fine with a 24-month term and the 12% committed discount, but they want billing on a semi-annual schedule (rather than annual). Is that acceptable?

If we can get the SLA uptime and audit-retention language added to the amendment and confirm semi-annual invoices, procurement can sign and route to finance next week. We prefer DocuSign for the final signature.

Thanks — Carlos
VP, Procurement & Vendor Contracts
